resources.focus_tooltip: Focus determines prepared initiative and limits the secret duel bid.
resources.vigilance_tooltip: Vigilance determines unprepared initiative and often opposes Scheme actions.

warnings.no_void_tooltip: The character has no Void Points available.
warnings.compromised_tooltip: The system reports the character as Compromised.
warnings.incapacitated_tooltip: The system reports the character as Incapacitated.
warnings.dying_tooltip: The character has the Dying condition.

social.honor_tooltip: Exact Honor value and its tens rank.
social.glory_tooltip: Exact Glory value and its tens rank.
social.status_tooltip: Exact Status value and its tens rank.

skills.label: Skills
skills.generic_tooltip: Open the system Dice Picker to choose ring, skill, TN, action types, target, assistance, and Void Point.
skills.roll_tooltip: Open the system Dice Picker for this skill and the currently selected ring.

equipment.label: Equipment
equipment.choose_attack_profile: Choose a weapon or unarmed profile
equipment.active_weapon_tooltip: Open the weapon sheet. Hover to show its active Range bands on Tactical Grid.
equipment.release_hands: Release at least {remaining} more hand(s), or cancel without spending the action.

techniques.label: Techniques
techniques.available: May be rolled through the system Dice Picker.
techniques.informational_only: Informational only: no structured skill metadata.
techniques.context_unknown: Context is not encoded in the item; verify legality before rolling.

unmask.label: Unmask
unmask.confirm: Unmask and remove all current Strife? This does not consume the normal action.
unmask.description_hint: Add a short narrative description for the chat card.

generic_roll.label: Custom Roll
generic_roll.tooltip: Open the system Dice Picker without replacing the L5R Roll and Keep engine.

assist.label: Assist
assist.tooltip: Open a Support check for the selected target.

calming_breath.label: Calming Breath
calming_breath.tooltip: During a conflict, remove 1 Fatigue and/or 1 Strife when each value exceeds half its threshold. Uses an action, including the eligible Water stance extra action.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.tooltip: Open a Scheme check against the current target.

center.label: Center
center.tooltip: Choose a skill, roll through the system picker in Void, and record the final kept dice for this duel.

predict.label: Predict
predict.tooltip: Commit a secret ring prediction for the targeted opponent. Only a hash is stored until reveal.
predict.committed: A secret prediction has been committed.

prepare_item.label: Prepare Item
prepare_item.tooltip: Ready or stow equipment through the system equipment transaction, including occupied-hand decisions.

strike.label: Strike
strike.tooltip: Strike with a readied weapon or a legal unarmed profile through the system Dice Picker as an Attack action.

throw_item.label: Throw Item
throw_item.tooltip: House Rule: throw any held item with the configured improvised profile. A thrown grip remains Strike and Soaring Slice remains a technique.

guard.label: Guard
guard.tooltip: Open the Tactics Support check and track Guard for this turn.

maneuver.label: Maneuver
maneuver.tooltip: Open a Fitness Move check and track the action separately from free movement.

wait.label: Wait
wait.tooltip: Record a trigger condition and spend the normal action.

custom_action.label: Unique / Custom
custom_action.tooltip: Open a configurable system check for a unique action.

persuade.label: Persuade
persuade.tooltip: Open a Scheme check. TN uses the highest targeted Vigilance and remains hidden when the target's data is not observable.

assault.label: Assault
assault.tooltip: Open an Attack check for the selected Mass Battle context.

rally.label: Rally
rally.tooltip: Open a Command Support check for the selected Mass Battle context.

reinforce.label: Reinforce
reinforce.tooltip: Open a Labor or Tactics Support check for the selected Mass Battle context.

staredown.label: Staredown
staredown.tooltip: Apply mandatory round Strife, commit a secret bid up to Focus, and reveal all valid commitments together.
staredown.committed: The secret bid has been committed.

end_turn.label: End Turn
end_turn.tooltip: Advance Combat after the active combatant has finished. This does not spend an action slot.

free_movement.label: Free Movement
free_movement.tooltip: Mark free movement as used for this turn.

notifications.conflict_only: This action is available only during an active conflict.
notifications.no_action: No eligible action remains for this turn.
notifications.not_active_turn: Only the currently active combatant can end the turn.
notifications.movement_used: Free movement has already been used.
notifications.calming_breath_no_effect: Neither Fatigue nor Strife exceeds half its threshold.
notifications.duel_participants: A Staredown requires at least two character combatants.
notifications.bid_already_committed: A bid was already committed for this round.

trackers.selection_required: Multiple linked records exist; select the intended context.

objectives.appeal: Appeal to a Person or Group
